mechanism_narrative: Sustained FEDFUNDS below 2% for 6 months signals accommodative policy, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in walk-forward) or IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in UNRATE above 4.5% in 3 months signals wage inflation pressures, reducing corporate profits and causing negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns positive despite UNRATE crossing above 4.5% threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (industrial production) above their 5-week moving averages signal robust corporate demand and equity inflows, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or lack of correlation between proxies and returns.

mechanism_narrative: During a 'monetary tightening cycle', FEDFUNDS crossing above 4.5% triggers higher interest rates, compressing equity valuations and causing negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns positive in tightening regime despite FEDFUNDS >4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in INDPRO (supply) indicates robust production growth, lowering inflation expectations and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: PAYEMS (employment) crossing a new high by 0.5% in a month signals labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > previous high by 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns not positive or insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (retail sales) above their 3-month moving averages indicate strong corporate demand, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly positive or proxies not jointly significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a 'late-cycle expansion' regime, INDPRO peaking followed by a >5% drop in the next month signals overvaluation, causing negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO peaks then drops >5% in next month and regime:late_cycle_expansion
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns positive despite INDPRO peak-to-drop pattern in late-cycle regime.
